description.value: Rivendell Retreat Centre is a Christian contemplative community and place of retreat situated on Bowen Island, a short BC Ferries ride from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. The centre offers individual and group retreats across several sacred spaces — a Lodge, Cottage, Hermitage, and writers' cottage — set amid forest trails with views of mountains and sea. Retreatants bring their own food and share a communal kitchen, and the grounds include a network of walking trails through old-growth forest.

address.value: 600 Rivendell Rd, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and active, showing a 2026 booking schedule and confirming the business is operating. The phone number (604-947-0077) matches OSM exactly; the physical address (600 Rivendell Rd, Bowen Island) and mailing address (PO Box 402, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G0) are provided by the website but absent from OSM. No mention of bikes, bike storage, Wi-Fi, laundry, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website, so all such criteria default to null. The OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the facility is clearly on Bowen Island, accessible only by ferry.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the facility is located on Bowen Island, accessible only by BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay — the community attribution is misleading.
OSM address field is empty; physical address (600 Rivendell Rd, Bowen Island) and mailing address (PO Box 402, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G0) are taken from website only.
Advance booking required; this is not a walk-in or drop-in accommodation — cyclists must reserve in advance and arrivals are restricted to after 3pm.
OSM email tag (rivendell@telus.net) is the general contact address; website also lists a separate booking email (booking@rivendellretreat.org) for reservations.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, bookable overnight accommodation on Bowen Island; 2026 retreat schedule confirms it is open. Useful to touring cyclists needing a place to stay on the island.
enrichment_extras.notes: The retreat emphasises silence and a contemplative atmosphere; cyclists should be aware this is a faith-based environment with community prayer periods. The centre explicitly welcomes people of all backgrounds regardless of religion.

wow_evidence: Christian contemplative community on Bowen Island, old-growth forest trails, ferry-accessed island retreat
